quest.title: The Sound of Discord
quest.description: Vile has caught wind of some concerning news and would like you to go and investigate.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Crestfallen Citizen
dialogues.text: Don't worry about me. I just need a bit of time to get my feelings under control again.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Why, if it isn't the Traveler. We meet again. How are you finding the city's atmosphere?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's pretty good.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: And it's good that you think so. Still... this might not quite fit in with the festive mood, but perhaps you might be able to help me with something related to the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Well, more accurately, "that gentleman" would like your help in this matter.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I thought people didn't go around asking others to do stuff during the Windblume Festival...

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Ah, don't fret. This request does not fall within the usual strictures of the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: As you've surely noticed, the Windblume Festival is a most busy time. People come and go, hustle and bustle... Almost everyone's completely immersed in the festive mood. The Knights will be too busy maintaining order to pay any attention to anything else...

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Defenseless crowds, overworked Knights... To ones such as the Treasure Hoarders, this must surely be a great opportunity.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: According to intelligence from that gentleman, some Treasure Hoarders have already infiltrated the city in all the hubbub, and are currently amidst the shops, pretending to enjoy the festival, when they are simply laying the groundwork for future operations.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: If the Knights begin a large-scale search now, they will not only alert the Treasure Hoarders but also ruin the atmosphere. Yet we cannot leave these criminals be...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And this is where I come in.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Of course. That gentleman specifically asked for you in this case, too. According to him, you're the best person for the job.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Alright then, let's get to the heart of things. According to the intelligence that I've gathered, the infiltrating Treasure Hoarders all carry <color=#00E1FFFF>a pouch</color> to help identify each other, and will use a <color=#00E1FFFF>code</color> to confirm their comrades' identities.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>When the wind blows the flowers about — that's when bystanders should watch out.</color>

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Those who can recite this code would be our infiltrators. You should be able to get the location of their outdoor base from them.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Once you have that intel in hand, please take the opportunity to take care of all of them.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And the Knights can't help with this?

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Why, they must be at their wits' end just trying to maintain order during the festival.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: At times like these, it's the duty of concerned citizens to... share the load a little.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Well, we're counting on you, Honorary Knight.

dialogues.speaker: Restless Citizen
dialogues.text: Eh? What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When the wind blows the flowers about...

dialogues.speaker: Restless Citizen
dialogues.text: Wind? Flowers? You mean the Dandelions?

dialogues.speaker: Restless Citizen
dialogues.text: What about that? It's totally normal.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, it's nothing. Sorry for disturbing you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that seems to have been an ordinary citizen. Let's go ask someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Crestfallen Citizen
dialogues.text: I wonder if I still have a chance...

dialogues.speaker: Crestfallen Citizen
dialogues.text: Hmm? Is something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When the wind blows the flowers about...

dialogues.speaker: Crestfallen Citizen
dialogues.text: Well, yes, that's this time of the year for sure. I know, I know, I should be enjoying it.

dialogues.speaker: Crestfallen Citizen
dialogues.text: Actually, that's true. Why should I be so down just because I got rejected? This festival isn't over yet.

dialogues.speaker: Crestfallen Citizen
dialogues.text: Thanks for your encouragement. I'll pick myself back up for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like that person misunderstood. Well, at least they're not someone suspicious...

talks.objective: Look for the suspicious person with the package

dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Citizen
dialogues.text: Wonderful, this place is positively bustling!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When the wind blows the flowers about...

dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Citizen
dialogues.text: Oh? Hmm... that's when bystanders should watch out.

dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Citizen
dialogues.text: Ah, so you're one of ours. You're just in time: I've got my eyes on a pair of careless little lovebirds. What say we go get us some Mora, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Citizen
dialogues.text: You attract their attention, I'll cut their purses. Once we've got 'em, let's head back to Windrise to meet up with the rest. Wonder how they're doing...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, sure. You're just going to have to go on a little trip with me first.

dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Citizen
dialogues.text: Eh!? Wait, you ain't a Treasure Hoarder. Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just a friendly neighborhood Knight.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, guess that's one guy in Knight custody. But Paimon wonders how they got here so fast...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, guess that's not too important. Didn't he say that they were going to meet up at Windrise? Let's go check it out.

talks.objective: Go to the Treasure Hoarder camp
Clear out the Treasure Hoarder camp

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: How goes the matter of the Treasure Hoarders?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They won't be giving us any trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Ah, as expected of the Honorary Knight. Well done. You did well chatting that Treasure Hoarder up previously as well... as expected of the one that gentleman has his eye on.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, have you been watching us this whole time?

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Why, of course! How else was I going to call the Knights over in the nick of time, hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: All in all, thank you for your help. Please take these, and don't be shy about it. These are funds that our dear gentleman set aside for me to use.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: I'll see you around, then. Have a nice day.

dialogues.speaker: Restless Citizen
dialogues.text: *sigh* What flowers should I send...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that's settled, then. We should go report back to Vile.
